headline: I build the systems you can't afford to hire for yet.
subhead: Digital infrastructure for founders and creatives coming up from nothing.
lede: Marketing ops, data, and AI tooling — the machinery big companies pay whole teams for, handed to the people building from scratch. I came up building my own, so I'm not guessing at what you need. I back builders before it's obvious. That's who the future belongs to.
about: I'm Bogdan — Ukrainian, Winnipeg-based, trilingual. I've got a BCom from the Asper School of Business, management information systems and marketing, which is the long way of saying I studied the exact seam I work on now: where the systems meet the story.

I build the digital infrastructure young businesses run on. CRM and automation, dashboards, data pipelines, AI tooling — shipped end to end, mostly solo, built not bought. No inherited runway, no team handed to me. I learned by making the thing until it worked.

I work with the people coming up: founders and creatives building from nothing, who need the machinery before they can afford the headcount. I back them early because I know what it's like from that spot. It tastes different when you got it out the mud.
This site is one of the systems. Look around.

contact.formIntro: No forms-into-the-void. This lands in my inbox and I answer it myself. Tell me what you're building.
